Seeing Memory leaks with this test in 2.17 @bmatican 
https://gist.github.com/kripasreenivasan/28fb4af766978f9950bc580850c1e5a7

Reproduced in **RELEASE** only:  failed ~ **7** / 100
`ybd release --cxx-test integration-tests_cql-index-test --gtest_filter CqlIndexTest.TestSaturatedWorkers -n 100`

So, in ~7% cases we have error "Request timed out" instead of expected error "Timed out waiting for prepare child status".

```
[m-1] I1109 23:39:13.633924 157797 backfill_index.cc:266] t [id=22f1cce4d8d849d19606f43eb5e5493b] - Alter table completed version=8, state: RUNNING

[ts-1] W1109 23:39:13.635977 157674 process_context.cc:184] SQL Error: Wrong Metadata Version. schema version mismatch for table 22f1cce4d8d849d19606f43eb5e5493b: expected 8, got 7 (compt with prev: 1)
BEGIN TRANSACTION INSERT INTO t (key, v1, v2) VALUES (0, 0, 0); INSERT INTO t (key, v1, v2) VALUES (1, 1, 1);
... INSERT INTO t (key, v1, v2) VALUES (578, 578, 578);

../../src/yb/integration-tests/cql-index-test.cc:323: Failure
Expected: (status.message().ToBuffer().find("Timed out waiting for prepare child status")) != (std::string::npos), actual: 18446744073709551615 vs 18446744073709551615
```
